name: Guntur Inner Ring Road
history: Guntur's inner ring road loops around the western side of the city, carrying traffic between the highways to Vijayawada, Chilakaluripet and Amaravati without going through the middle of a crowded commercial town. Guntur is the centre of India's chilli trade and its market traffic is heavy year round.
facts: Rings the western side of Guntur, in Andhra Pradesh's Amaravati capital region.
Guntur holds one of the largest chilli markets in Asia.
It links the roads towards Vijayawada, Chilakaluripet and the Amaravati capital area.
significance: Guntur sits in the middle of the Amaravati capital region and is a major agricultural market town. This ring is what keeps its through traffic moving.
